root_cause.text: The error path in ath12k_mac_op_change_vif_links skips link deletion for arvifs that were initialized but not created (arvif->is_created false), leaving a stale entry in ahvif->links_map that triggers a WARN_ON when a new arvif is later initialized with the same link id.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description: "link deletion only executes when arvif->is_created is true. As a result, ahvif retains a stale entry of arvif that is initialized but not created." Patch diff adds `ath12k_mac_unassign_link_vif(arvif);` inside the `if (!arvif->is_created)` block to clear the stale mapping.

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure proper cleanup by unassigning the link VIF before skipping it in the change_vif_links function when the VIF is not created.
intent_record.what: Added a call to ath12k_mac_unassign_link_vif(arvif) inside the if (!arvif->is_created) block, before the continue statement, and enclosed both statements in braces.
intent_record.how: When arvif->is_created is false, the driver now unassigns the link VIF before continuing to the next iteration, ensuring proper cleanup instead of skipping without cleanup.
